QuestInfo.name: Burning Thirst
QuestInfo.0: #bChristopher#k has been subjected to forced labor in Twilight Perion, and he'd like to talk to you.
QuestInfo.1: Christopher hasn't been able to get a drink of water because of the #bsupply constraints#k placed on his camp. Retrieve some #bFresh Sap#k from #rSwollen Dark Stump#k monsters for him.

0.0: So... so... #rthirsty#k... The guards won't give me a drink until I finish my work, but... I'm so dehydrated. Anything to quench this thirst...
0.1: M-maybe the ...#bsap from the Swollen Dark Stumps#k... could quench my thirst?

yes.0: P-please. 25 dollops of #bFresh Sap#k... I might be able... to finish a little earlier today... if I have something to drink.

no.0: Oh... I suppose I have to endure... I'll be... okay.

1.0: Is... Is that #bFresh Sap?#k Let me have it...

yes.0: Thank you. I'd better hurry up and finish my work...
yes.1: I feel better now... I wonder why. Nothing really changed... Did something change without me knowing?

item.0: Not yet? I can wait... For 25 dollops of #bFresh Sap#k... I can wait...
